service.description: inbox-source: an app that keeps the user's messages beyond mail answers the Inbox's operations (org.moqui.comms.InboxServices.run#Operation names them: get#InboxData, find#InboxRows, get#ThreadView, send#Compose, get#CommsHome and the others) with handled true and result, the operation's out-parameters, for parameters, its in-parameters; its answer is the whole answer, its page the list. handled false leaves an operation to the framework. operation accounts answers the app's own accounts (accountList, the Internal account). operation features answers in result what the app's answers support beyond the framework's, for a client that works offline (merged into /qapps/clientConfig's features): internalSendRef (send#Compose of an internal message is made once by its clientRef) and mailChangesUncovered (the stores get#MailChanges does not cover, as its uncoveredStores).

parameter.name: operation
parameter.description: An Inbox operation, accounts or features

service.description: recipient-source: people, groups and lists with addresses for a text (recipientList), each {itemId (unique in the source), kind, name, and its addresses; for kinds phone (the Dialer, V3), phoneList [{number in E.164, label}]}, at most limit, the source's own page (recipientListCount, its total). Authority is the signed-in user's.

parameter.name: kinds
parameter.description: A comma list of person, group, list and phone (recipients with phone numbers); empty for all

service.description: record-lookup, by operation (org.moqui.comms.ChatScreenServices.lookup#Records combines the answers): info (records [{recordEntityName, recordId}]: recordList of {recordEntityName, recordId, entity, visible, title, typeLabel, url, icon}), card (recordEntityName, recordId: card, as m-record-card shows it), search (text: optionList of {value: entity|id, label}) and links (body: recordList of {entity, id}, the records a message's links name). A record the user may not see is answered visible false, or not at all.
record-link: link a message (emailMessageId) or a chat event (chatRoomId, eventSeq) to a record; answers the link (recordUrl).
create-from: make a record of kind from a message or a chat event; answers its url (recordUrl).

invitation: answer the calendar invitation a message carries (accept, tentative or decline), as the user: put it on their calendar and tell its organizer (org.moqui.comms.InboxServices.respond#Invitation calls it, and the first provider that answers is the answer). Answers the event (workEffortId, statusId), whether a reply went out (replySent) and a link to the event (eventUrl); a refusal is an error.

contact-card: who an address (or a party the item names) is, as the user may see it, for the contact card of the Inbox's reading pane (org.moqui.comms.InboxServices.get#ContactCard calls it). card {emailAddress, name, partyId, isPrivate, organizationName, phone, emailList, url (the contact's record), recentList (the latest threads with it, each {threadKey, subject, date})}; a provider that does not know it answers no partyId and no url, and the framework shows the address alone.
meetings-source: the user's meetings in a range, each with its call link (meetingList).

call-context: who a caller is and their open records, for a screen pop (V5: the ring bar and m-call, CallServices.get#CallContext, as the user rung). number is E.164. Answers contactList (each {name, kind: person or organization, url, detail}) and recordList (each {title, status, url}), at most 10 and 20, only what the user may see.

home-source: the boxes it adds to Comms Home (org.moqui.comms.CommsHomeServices.get#HomeSources calls it, after the Home's own parts, whoever answered them): cardList, each {key, title, link (to more), linkText, emptyText, rowList (ten at most, each {title, detail, countText, link})}, as the user may see them.

external-conversation: file the conversation of a new outside party (an SMS number pair's room, C4-SMS) on a record, from its first message (eventSeq, sent by the external actor chatActorId), as the room's first local member (org.moqui.chat.ChatBridgeServices.file#ExternalConversation calls it). Tried again on the room's next message until one provider filed it, with the same idempotencyKey, which must not file it twice. Answers filed (false: nothing here matched it) and the record's link (recordUrl).

sms-consent (C4-SMS): whether a promotional text may go from our number fromNumber to toNumber, as the caller's user (org.moqui.call.SmsServices check#SmsSend). consent true allows it, false refuses it whatever another provider says; with no provider saying true, a promotional text is refused (consentRequired).

call-target: which of the users in userIdList the current user may not call, transfer a call to or add to a call (org.moqui.call.CallTransferServices transfer#Call and add#CallParticipant, CallServices start#Call), for an app that keeps them to the user's own (IronStone: the user's organizations). A user named in any provider's refusedUserIdList is refused, with the same answer as a user that does not exist; with no provider every enabled user may be reached; a provider that fails refuses them all.
